# ADR 0002: Versioned rule sets stored with every decision

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Mortgage application decision API

## Context

Decisions must be reproducible and explainable months later.

## Decision

Rule thresholds are data with versions; each decision stores inputs, version and reason codes.

## Consequences

Any decision can be replayed. Rule changes need a process (two-person activation).

## Alternatives considered

Rules hard-coded in Java.
